description: This PHP source file defines the class OA_Dll_BannerInfo, which extends OA_Info and encapsulates information about banners in the Revive Adserver project, including properties like banner ID, campaign ID, storage type, image URLs, dimensions, and methods for setting defaults, encoding images, and retrieving field types.

classes.name: OA_Dll_BannerInfo
classes.description: Class representing banner information with properties for banner attributes and methods for default setup, image encoding, and field type retrieval.

methods.name: setDefaultForAdd
methods.description: Initializes default values for a new banner instance.

methods.name: encodeImage
methods.description: Encodes image data into an XML_RPC_Value structure.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the object properties into an array, including encoded images.

methods.name: getFieldsTypes
methods.description: Returns an array mapping property names to their data types.
